title: Tender Qualification
description: A go/no-go screening decision for a remedial-building tender, captured at the moment it lands — before a customer, job, or contract record exists in EQ. One record per tender, not a batch. The write target is a decision (price / walk / needs_review) with a reasoning trail, not a job record. Sits outside the canonical staff/site/asset spine deliberately: no customer/site/contact FK is required because this is pre-sale.

qualification_id.description: Primary key. Minted client-side or by eq_intake_commit_qualification on first save.

customer_name_raw.description: The prospective client's name as it appears on the tender documents. Free text, no FK — no customer row exists yet at qualification time.

contact_raw.description: The tender's named contact (name / role / phone / email as extracted), free text. No contact FK — pre-sale.

site_address_raw.description: The site or project address as it appears on the tender documents. Free text, no site FK.

scope_summary.description: Vision-extracted plain-language summary of the scope of works from the contract + spec documents.

contract_value_estimate.description: Estimated total contract value in AUD, extracted or manually entered. Feeds the margin and cash-flow factors.

margin_estimate_pct.description: Estimated margin percentage after all costs, BEFORE any optimistic variations are assumed. Compared against the tenant's configured minimum in the go/no-go margin factor.

risk_answers.description: The 8-factor go/no-go matrix (business plan §8), one entry per factor. Shape: { "<factor>": { "answer": "preferred"|"no_go"|"needs_review", "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "source": "extracted"|"manual", "notes": string|null } }. An unanswerable factor MUST be recorded as needs_review, never silently defaulted to preferred (EQ-AS-CONDUIT rule #11) — mirrors the cycle_costs JSONB pattern already used in contract_scope.

decision.description: The go/no-go outcome. null while the qualification is still a draft with no decision run yet.

decision_reason.description: The reasoning trail behind `decision` — ALWAYS populated whenever decision is set, never just the label (EQ-AS-CONDUIT rule #11 / plan §C.1). Typically the joined per-factor reasons from the rules.ts evaluator.

decision_made_by.description: The user who ran or confirmed the decision. Null for an unattended/system-only evaluation.

source_files.description: Self-contained audit trail of the documents this qualification was extracted from — contract, spec, photos.

status.description: Import/decision lifecycle. 'draft' = still being answered. 'decided' = a decision has been recorded. 'archived' = withdrawn/superseded — the only form of rollback (a plain status update; there is no delete RPC).

answer.description: needs_review means the factor could not be confidently answered — it is the explicit non-silent default, never omitted in place of a guess.

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0. Null for a manually-answered factor where confidence isn't meaningful.

x-eq-cross-field-rules.rule: decision == null OR (decision_reason != null AND decision_reason.trim().length > 0)
x-eq-cross-field-rules.message: decision_reason must be populated whenever decision is set — a decision without its reasoning trail is a silent drop (EQ-AS-CONDUIT rule #11).
status is 'decided' but decision is null — a decided qualification must carry an actual decision.
